digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutant counts in stale records (491 in signing.py) conflict with current pinned mutmut 3.7.0 probe findings (814 mutants), including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps, preventing enforcement of old ceilings without blocking unrelated work.

Mutation enforcement must progress through three explicit modes—advisory (evidence-gathering only), ratchet (fresh base/head comparison with selective regression blocking), and strict (complete killed-or-fingerprinted requirement)—each promoted only after demonstrated stability and runtime evidence.

Selector must map changed source, test, support files, and global inputs to shard sets while respecting renames, reporting unmapped tests, and failing on unresolved refs; mutation infrastructure changes select all shards.

Per-shard enforcement requires fresh isolated base/head workspaces with no persisted mutation verdict cache, pinned mutmut 3.7.0 with --max-children 1, canonical timeout constants (1.0 + 15.0 multiplier), and selective per-mutant/per-job timeouts.

Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged AST-identical legacy survivors and report newly introduced no-tests outcomes without blocking, while blocking killed regressions, new survivors, timeouts, and incomplete statuses for changed functions unless individually reviewed equivalent fingerprints exist.

Documentation and contract test must assert live phased-mode policy, deterministic promotion process, false-positive handling, manifest authority via .github/mutation-shards.toml, and absence of stale score or budget tables.
